meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 装好后，让 Claude 做前端界面，它会先定一个鲜明的视觉方向，再产出可直接运行的 HTML/CSS/JS、React 等代码，并在字体、配色、动效和布局上避开常见的“AI 味”。
howto.when: 当你提出要构建网页组件、页面或应用等前端界面，或给出这类设计需求时接管。

say.text: 用一个复古未来风设计这个产品落地页
say.note: 会先定视觉方向，再写页面代码

say.text: 做一张暗色、衬线字体的关于页，不要普通科技感
say.note: 会避开常见字体和配色套路

say.text: 给这个卡片加一个让人记得住的鼠标悬停效果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will commit to a clear visual direction for the frontend interface it's asked to build, then output runnable HTML/CSS/JS, React, etc. code. It deliberately avoids common AI-slop choices in typography, color, motion, and layout.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to build a frontend interface such as a web component, page, or app, or when you share frontend design requirements.

say_en.text: Design this product landing page with a retro-futuristic style.
say_en.note: It picks a visual direction first, then writes the code.

say_en.text: Create an about page with a dark palette and serif typography.
say_en.note: It avoids common fonts and color cliches.

say_en.text: Add a memorable hover effect to this card.
say_en.note: The motion fits the overall style.
